note: Static SRC-lane seed detectors. A hit is a SEED, not a finding. Every hit must pass Q1 (write the exact attacker request) before it is reported. Confidence reflects false-positive rate, not severity. Regex patterns are intentionally conservative to keep signal high.

detectors.title: AWS access key id
detectors.rationale: AWS long-term access key id format.
detectors.killUnless: The key is live (not a rotated/docs placeholder) and authenticates a request.

detectors.title: AWS secret access key assignment
detectors.rationale: 40-char AWS secret assigned in source.
detectors.killUnless: The secret is live and paired with a usable access key id.

detectors.title: PEM private key block
detectors.rationale: Embedded private key material.
detectors.killUnless: The key is production and grants access to an in-scope asset.

detectors.title: Google API key
detectors.rationale: Google API key format.
detectors.killUnless: The key is live and its API surface has security impact (not a public Maps browser key).

detectors.title: Slack token
detectors.rationale: Slack bot/user/app token format.
detectors.killUnless: The token still authenticates to Slack.

detectors.title: Slack incoming webhook
detectors.rationale: Slack webhook URL grants message-post to a channel.
detectors.killUnless: The webhook still posts.

detectors.title: Stripe live secret key
detectors.rationale: Stripe live secret key format.
detectors.killUnless: The key is live (not sk_test).

detectors.title: GitHub token
detectors.rationale: GitHub personal/OAuth/server token format.
detectors.killUnless: The token still authenticates to GitHub.

detectors.title: npm access token
detectors.rationale: npm automation/access token.
detectors.killUnless: The token still authenticates to the registry.

detectors.title: Hardcoded JWT
detectors.rationale: A full JWT embedded in source; may be a live session/service token.
detectors.killUnless: The token is unexpired and grants access.

detectors.title: Generic credential assignment
detectors.rationale: Credential-looking assignment to a string literal; high false-positive rate (placeholders, fixtures).
detectors.killUnless: The value is a real, live secret — confirmed by using it or by entropy.

detectors.title: TLS/cert verification disabled
detectors.rationale: Certificate validation turned off enables MITM.
detectors.killUnless: The disabled path handles sensitive traffic on an in-scope surface.

detectors.title: JWT alg 'none' accepted
detectors.rationale: Accepting alg=none disables signature verification.
detectors.killUnless: An unsigned token is accepted on a real endpoint.

detectors.title: JWT signature/expiry verification disabled
detectors.rationale: Verification/expiry checks disabled on token validation.
detectors.killUnless: A forged/expired token is accepted on a real endpoint.

detectors.title: PyJWT decode with verify=False
detectors.rationale: PyJWT decode without signature verification.
detectors.killUnless: The decoded claims drive an auth decision.

detectors.title: ORM object fetched directly by request id
detectors.rationale: Object looked up by user-supplied id with no visible owner/tenant scope.
detectors.killUnless: The fetched object is returned/mutated without a caller-scope check → cross-account access.

detectors.title: Rails unscoped Model.find(params[:id])
detectors.rationale: Model.find on params id without current_user scope is the classic IDOR.
detectors.killUnless: No association scope (current_user.x.find) guards it.

detectors.title: Authoritative identity read from request body
detectors.rationale: Trust anchor taken from the request instead of the authenticated session.
detectors.killUnless: That id is used for authorization, not just logging.

detectors.title: Model write from full req.body
detectors.rationale: Whole request body written to a model enables privileged-attribute injection.
detectors.killUnless: A privileged field (role/is_admin/owner/balance) is writable.

detectors.title: Object.assign from request into model
detectors.rationale: Untrusted keys merged onto a trusted object.
detectors.killUnless: A privileged field is reachable this way.

detectors.title: Rails permit includes privileged attribute
detectors.rationale: Strong-params allowlist includes a privileged column.
detectors.killUnless: Setting it changes authorization/state.

detectors.title: Server fetch of user-supplied URL
detectors.rationale: Outbound fetch whose target may be attacker-controlled.
detectors.killUnless: The URL reaches internal/metadata targets past any allowlist (SSRF).

detectors.title: URL built from request then fetched
detectors.rationale: URL constructed from user input; often feeds a server fetch.
detectors.killUnless: The constructed URL is fetched server-side and can hit internal hosts.

detectors.title: SQL built by string concatenation with user input
detectors.rationale: String-concatenated SQL with request-derived input.
detectors.killUnless: The concatenated value is not parameterized/escaped → injection.

detectors.title: SQL in a template literal with interpolation
detectors.rationale: Interpolated template-literal SQL.
detectors.killUnless: The interpolated value is user-controlled and unparameterized.

detectors.title: NoSQL $where / where with user input
detectors.rationale: Mongo $where accepts JS; user input here is injection.
detectors.killUnless: The clause evaluates attacker JS/operators.

detectors.title: Shell exec of user input (Node)
detectors.rationale: User input reaching a shell exec.
detectors.killUnless: Input reaches a shell (exec, or spawn with shell:true) unescaped.

detectors.title: Shell exec of user input (Python)
detectors.rationale: User input reaching a subprocess.
detectors.killUnless: Input reaches a shell (shell=True or os.system) unescaped.

detectors.title: subprocess with shell=True
detectors.rationale: shell=True is dangerous when any argument is user-influenced.
detectors.killUnless: An argument is user-controlled.

detectors.title: Dynamic eval/Function of user input
detectors.rationale: User input into eval/Function is code execution.
detectors.killUnless: The evaluated string is attacker-controlled.

detectors.title: Flask render_template_string with input
detectors.rationale: User input into a Jinja string template is SSTI.
detectors.killUnless: Attacker input reaches the template source.

detectors.title: XML parser with external entities enabled
detectors.rationale: XML parsing with entity expansion allows XXE.
detectors.killUnless: A user-supplied document is parsed and entities are expanded.

detectors.title: Python pickle.loads on untrusted data
detectors.rationale: Pickle deserialization is RCE on untrusted input.
detectors.killUnless: The bytes are attacker-controlled.

detectors.title: yaml.load without SafeLoader
detectors.rationale: Unsafe yaml.load instantiates arbitrary Python objects.
detectors.killUnless: The document is attacker-controlled.

detectors.title: marshal.loads on untrusted data
detectors.rationale: marshal is not safe for untrusted data.
detectors.killUnless: The bytes are attacker-controlled.

detectors.title: PHP unserialize on user input
detectors.rationale: unserialize on superglobals is object-injection.
detectors.killUnless: A POP chain / magic method is reachable.

detectors.title: Java ObjectInputStream.readObject
detectors.rationale: Native Java deserialization sink.
detectors.killUnless: The stream is attacker-controlled and a gadget is on the classpath.

detectors.title: node-serialize unserialize
detectors.rationale: node-serialize unserialize executes IIFE payloads.
detectors.killUnless: The input is attacker-controlled.

detectors.title: File read/download from request path
detectors.rationale: Filesystem path derived from request enables traversal.
detectors.killUnless: '../' or an absolute path escapes the intended root.

detectors.title: path.join with request input
detectors.rationale: path.join does not prevent traversal.
detectors.killUnless: The joined path escapes the base directory.

detectors.title: postMessage listener (origin check?)
detectors.rationale: message listener without a nearby event.origin check trusts any sender.
detectors.killUnless: The handler performs a privileged action for an unchecked origin.

detectors.title: Reflected Origin in CORS header
detectors.rationale: Reflecting Origin (esp. with credentials) breaks the same-origin boundary.
detectors.killUnless: Allow-Credentials is true and a sensitive response is read cross-origin.

detectors.title: CORS allow-credentials true
detectors.rationale: Credentialed CORS is dangerous when the origin is reflected or wildcard.
detectors.killUnless: Paired with a reflected/permissive origin on a sensitive endpoint.

detectors.title: Prototype pollution sink
detectors.rationale: Direct __proto__ write or recursive merge gadget.
detectors.killUnless: User-controlled keys reach a merge/assign that pollutes Object.prototype.

detectors.title: Redirect target from request
detectors.rationale: Redirect Location derived from user input is open redirect / token-leak vector.
detectors.killUnless: An external URL is reachable (not path-only) → open redirect.

detectors.title: Weak RNG near a secret/token
detectors.rationale: Math.random()/rand() used to mint a token/key/nonce/OTP is predictable.
detectors.killUnless: The predicted value is accepted (reset token, session id, OTP).

detectors.title: Non-constant-time secret comparison
detectors.rationale: == / === on an hmac/signature/token leaks a timing oracle.
detectors.killUnless: The compared secret is remotely guessable via timing.

detectors.title: Missing return after auth failure
detectors.rationale: A 401/403 write not followed by return/throw lets execution fall through.
detectors.killUnless: The handler continues into the protected action after the failure branch.

detectors.title: Sensitive value written to a log
detectors.rationale: Credential-bearing field reaching a log/transcript (CWE-532).
detectors.killUnless: The log sink is reachable by an attacker (shared log, tool transcript, error response).

detectors.title: Debug/verbose mode enabled
detectors.rationale: Debug mode leaks stack traces / enables consoles.
detectors.killUnless: It is on in a production, in-scope deployment.

detectors.title: GraphQL introspection enabled
detectors.rationale: Introspection on production exposes the schema.
detectors.killUnless: It is on in production AND field-level authz gaps exist.
